title: CloudFormation: templates, stacks, change sets and drift

videos.script: A template is a promise. It says what should exist. CloudFormation turns it into a stack, and the stack remembers what it made. {{promise}} In production, two questions matter more than the template itself. {{two}} First. What will this change do, before it does it? A change set answers that. It lists every resource, and one word in it decides whether you go on. Replacement. {{changeset}} Second. What changed that nobody wrote down? Somebody fixed something in the console at two in the morning. The template did not hear about it. That is drift. {{drift}} This lesson runs a linter before AWS ever sees the file. It reads a change set the way a reviewer should. And it compares what was meant with what is, by hand, where moto cannot. {{lab}} By the end, the file is the truth again, and anything else is a change waiting to be written down. {{end}}
